title: Luke Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Luke 1: the angel's word to Zacharias, Gabriel's message to Mary, the visit to Elizabeth and the birth of John.

questions.text: To whom did the writer say he was writing his orderly account?
questions.explanation: He wrote that it seemed good to him, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write in order to most excellent Theophilus.

answers.text: To the priests of Abijah
To most excellent Theophilus
To the eyewitnesses of the word
To the people of Judea

questions.text: Why did Zacharias and Elizabeth have no child?
questions.explanation: They had no child because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.

answers.text: Because they had only just married in their old age
Because the child they had was taken from them
Because they had made a vow before the Lord
Because Elizabeth was barren and both were well advanced in years

questions.text: Where was the angel of the Lord standing when he appeared to Zacharias?
questions.explanation: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

answers.text: On the right side of the altar of incense
At the door of the temple of the Lord
Among the multitude praying outside
On the roof of the temple at Jerusalem

questions.text: What name did the angel tell Zacharias to give his son?
questions.explanation: The angel said that his wife Elizabeth will bear him a son, and that he shall call his name John.

answers.text: Zacharias
Elijah
John
Gabriel

questions.text: How did the angel name himself to Zacharias?
questions.explanation: The angel answered, "I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God," sent to speak to him and bring him this good news.

answers.text: Michael
Gabriel
A prophet of the Most High
A servant of the temple

questions.text: What happened to Zacharias because he did not believe the angel's words?
questions.explanation: The angel said he would be silent and not able to speak until the day these things happen, because he did not believe the words that would be fulfilled in their proper time.

answers.text: He was struck blind until the child was born
He was sent away from the temple for a year
He lost his place in the priestly division
He was silent and unable to speak until it happened

questions.text: To what city was the angel Gabriel sent in the sixth month, and to whom?
questions.explanation: In the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth, to a virgin named Mary, who was pledged to be married to Joseph of David's house.

answers.text: To Nazareth, to Mary
To Bethlehem, to Mary
To Jerusalem, to Elizabeth
To a city of Judah, to Joseph

questions.text: What happened when Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting?
questions.explanation: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

answers.text: She went out to meet her at the gate
She was unable to speak a word
The baby leaped in her womb
She sent for Zacharias at once

questions.text: In her song, what did Mary say God has done for the hungry and for the rich?
questions.explanation: She said he has filled the hungry with good things, and has sent the rich away empty.

answers.text: He has fed the hungry and the rich alike
He has filled the hungry and sent the rich away empty
He has made the rich give to the hungry
He has scattered both the hungry and the rich

questions.text: What did Zacharias write when they made signs to him about the child's name?
questions.explanation: He asked for a writing tablet and wrote, "His name is John," and they all marveled; then his mouth was opened and he spoke, blessing God.

answers.text: "Call him Zacharias"
"Let his mother choose"
"He will be a prophet"
"His name is John"
